title: Enforcement that python -O cannot delete
note: D-2026-73. EA1 turns one machine interlock back into an assert: the -O probe must see it allowed, and the repository-wide guard must see the assert. EA2 returns the guard to a list of directories, the scope that missed qta_full_sim.py's ten interlocks. EA3 returns the pin to a set of files, which let a second assert join a classified file unseen -- the docstring said 'the count is pinned' throughout.
